SFX Linux timezone reader: upstream date3.0.5, MIT licensed per source file.
Official archive and selected unmodified inputs are bound in SOURCE.json.

SFX compiles USE_OS_TZDB=0, HAS_REMOTE_API=0 and AUTO_DOWNLOAD=0. It uses the
private bundled IANA2026f text rules, not the host TZif transition table. The
initial SOURCE.json preparation purpose described the first OS-table candidate;
this file and cmake/SfxLinuxTimeZone.cmake describe the selected implementation.
No libcurl, Runtime network update, host timezone change or global TZ mutation.
Rules ship with the SFX installation and update through a later SFX update.
The Linux package must include the selected data and all upstream license
notices, including individual copyright headers in the date source files.

Legacy Windows keys use the pinned CLDR48 territory001 global default mapping.
The saved key is preserved and the resolved IANA name is available for display.
Unknown keys fail explicitly; there is no host-local or UTC fallback. Users
with a more specific region can choose its IANA zone in Region & Time.
